description: This PHP source file defines the 'AttendanceReport' class within the OrangeHRM module. The class implements report-related functionality for generating attendance reports, including filter parameter preparation, validation rules, header and filter definitions, data retrieval, and access control. It interacts with various entities such as Employee, JobTitle, Subunit, and EmploymentStatus, and uses traits for role management, text helpers, and internationalization.

classes.name: AttendanceReport
classes.description: Main class responsible for generating attendance reports in the OrangeHRM system. Implements methods for preparing filter parameters, validation rules, report headers and filters, data retrieval, and access control, utilizing various traits and interacting with multiple related entities.

methods.name: prepareFilterParams
methods.description: Prepares and returns filter parameters for the attendance report based on request query parameters, including employee number, job title, subunit, employment status, and date range.

methods.name: getValidationRule
methods.description: Returns validation rules for the report request parameters, ensuring proper existence and date validation, including logical date range checks.

methods.name: getHeaderDefinition
methods.description: Provides the report header configuration, defining columns for Employee Name and Time (Hours) with localization support.

methods.name: getFilterDefinition
methods.description: Returns the filter configuration for the report, which is an empty/default filter in this case.

methods.name: getData
methods.description: Retrieves and returns the report data based on the provided filter parameters.

methods.name: checkReportAccessibility
methods.description: Verifies if the current user has permission to access the attendance report, throwing a ForbiddenException if access is denied.
